projectDescription: A Node.js CLI tool that mirrors MaxMind GeoLite2 databases (Country, City, ASN) from MaxMind's servers, downloading only when the remote file is newer than the local copy.
keyFeatures: Downloads GeoLite2-Country, GeoLite2-City, and GeoLite2-ASN databases
Conditional downloads — only fetches when the remote is newer than the local copy (If-Modified-Since header)
License key via environment variable (MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY) or config.js
Configurable output directory via MAXMIND_DB_DIR environment variable
publicApiSurface: mirror.doOne(item, callback) — download a single database if remote is newer
mirror.isRemoteNewer(dest, httpOpts, callback) — check if remote file is newer than local
mirror.download(dest, opts, callback) — download and extract a tarball
config.geoIpDbs — array of {local, remote} database descriptors
